observations.formatter_input_model: At the actual server-fallback refusal callsite $dt receives ge. The query reducer computes ge as Jf({ permissionMode, mainLoopModel: br(), exceeds200kTokens }); br selects refusalOverride ?? fableConsentOverride ?? liveSwitchOverride ?? chainModel ?? primaryModel. ge may change after a model-switch transition. The actual callsite, override precedence, and plan clamp are separately pinned.
observations.refusal_eligibility: eYe(model) is KI(model) !== undefined. KI gates on environment capability rules, baked/dynamic catalog capability, Fable/EAP/default-Fable exceptions, a GrowthBook model roster for Mythos IDs, provider-kind routing, and an Opus-family-valid current fallback candidate. It does not consult organization availableModels membership.
observations.capability_order: fy uses an explicit CLAUDE_CODE_MODEL_CAPABILITIES match first (including false); a served runtime capability true second; then the hand-maintained baked Hsr catalog. The served callback returns only true or undefined and cannot veto a baked true; refusal_fallback is absent from the feature-gated S map, so its dynamic true is not blocked by that map.
observations.dynamic_vs_baked: La reads only Hsr, a hand-maintained baked catalog, for family/display_name/capabilities. The separate WQe path reads active or deactivated served-catalog rows and can provide dynamic custom-model names/runtime capabilities. Dynamic display labels are consulted only when nP(modelId) does not identify a baked provider ID; clean canonical built-in IDs use the baked label fallback.
observations.model_label: $o resolves the model picker label first, then the eligible dynamic catalog/custom model paths, then cE through baked La.display_name (and optional 1M context label), then a sanitized model spelling or unknown model. The full dynamic label cache and host modelKnowledge state remain live inputs.
observations.family_copy: Lw uses La(Nm(model))?.family and the baked $I family table. In this build first-time wording supports Sonnet/cyber and the explicit claude-opus-5-5 model exception; Dw suppresses it for Fable identity/aliases/configured default.
observations.provider_copy: He chooses gateway first from three host credential-slot facts, then the provider environment flags in Bedrock, Foundry, Anthropic AWS, Anthropic Google Cloud, Mantle, Vertex order, else firstParty. ad permits only firstParty, Anthropic AWS, Anthropic Google Cloud, or gateway.
observations.feedback_gate: QA is Nre()==null. Nre first applies raw truthiness disable flags for DISABLE_FEEDBACK_COMMAND / DISABLE_BUG_COMMAND and the nonessential-traffic mode, then checks dp(allow_product_feedback, /feedback, is). dp is a projection of the Native effective policy decision sn: allow gives null, deny/missing policy produces a non-null reason. The built-in key is server-populated, denied under hipaa/zdr, and deny-on-cache-miss.
observations.missing_runtime_inputs: The probe uses explicit settings-policy state, custom/served catalog records, model picker absence, current provider credentials, GrowthBook roster, model-switch state, and candidate model config. It does not reconstruct the Native account/model-catalog fetch, modelKnowledge resolver, the current account policy service, or dynamic model picker caches.
